questions.q: What was HR's actual complaint at Mill Creek Design Studio?
options: Requests over five consecutive days were being approved by whoever saw the email first, not a manager
Too many time-off requests were being submitted
The Time-Off Request object was missing fields
Employees were not submitting requests at all
questions.explain: That specific complaint is what the lab's entry criteria needs to target -- not every request, only the longer ones.

questions.q: Why does entry criteria written as `Days_Requested__c > 0` fail the lab's acceptance criteria?
options: It's a syntax error in Salesforce
It routes every request, including a single sick day, into the same queue HR wanted reserved for longer requests
It only works for managers, not directors
It cannot be saved in Setup
questions.explain: This is the lesson's named common mistake -- criteria that doesn't match the actual complaint it's meant to solve.

questions.q: What does the lab's acceptance criteria require regarding the locking decision?
options: Locking must always be turned on, no exceptions
Locking is optional and doesn't need to be mentioned
The locking decision must be stated AND justified, not just chosen silently
Locking only applies to approval processes with two steps
questions.explain: A locking choice without a stated reason doesn't demonstrate the reasoning the design is meant to practice.

questions.q: Which document from an earlier lesson is the lab's design meant to be written up in?
options: A brand-new template introduced in this lesson
A Salesforce-generated audit log
No documentation is required for this lab
The five-question documentation template from Lesson 13
questions.explain: The lab explicitly reuses Lesson 13's purpose/trigger/affects/dependencies/owner template.

questions.q: What environment does the guide recommend building this lab's design in?
options: Directly in a production org
A sandbox or Developer Edition org, never against production data
A spreadsheet only, with no Salesforce org involved
It doesn't matter which environment is used
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly warns against building and testing against production data.
